title: Kullu to Manali: Distance 40 km, Right-Bank Highway or Left-Bank Road via Naggar, Bus, Taxi and Stops (2026)
seo_title: Kullu to Manali: Distance 40 km, Route, Bus & Stops
seo_desc: Kullu to Manali is about 40 km, 1–1.5 hours up the Beas on NH-3, or about 45 km by the quieter left-bank road via Naggar. Local buses, taxis and stops on the way.
